cards.text: Joshua, Israel's leader, dismisses the people, and the Israelites go out to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance. You know when you get the keys to your first place and walk around touching every wall? Now picture a WHOLE NATION doing that.

cards.question: All through Joshua's days, the people serve the LORD.
Israel keeps serving the LORD through the days of the ___ who outlived Joshua.

cards.text: These elders had seen all the great works that the LORD had done for Israel. Not a rumor in a group chat. SEEN.
Then Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, dies at the age of 110.

cards.question: Joshua son of Nun has died. Where do they bury him?

answers.text: In the land of his own inheritance
Back at the camp in Gilgal

cards.text: Then that whole generation is gathered to their fathers, and another generation rises up.

cards.question: A new generation rises up after Joshua's is gone. What's different about these people?

answers.text: They did not know the LORD or His works
They did not know the land of their inheritance
They did not know which tribe they came from

cards.question: The generation after Joshua's serves the LORD just like the elders did.

cards.text: They do evil in the sight of the LORD and serve the Baals, false gods. They forsake the LORD, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt.

cards.question: Israel's new generation follows other gods and bows down to them. Whose gods are they?

answers.text: The gods of the peoples around them
The gods of Egypt they left behind

cards.text: They serve Baal and the Ashtoreths, more false gods, and they provoke the LORD to anger. His anger burns against Israel, and He delivers them into the hands of those who plunder them.

cards.question: With the LORD handing Israel over to plunderers, how does Israel do against their enemies all around?

answers.text: They can no longer resist them
They make peace with all of them

cards.question: Wherever Israel marches out, the hand of the LORD is against them to bring ___.
The calamity that meets Israel comes just as the LORD had sworn to them.

cards.text: So Israel is greatly distressed. I think this one hurts, friend.
Israel's in DEEP trouble, friend. But the LORD isn't finished with them: He raises up judges.

cards.question: What do the judges the LORD raises up do?

answers.text: Write down new laws for Israel

cards.text: Instead, they prostitute themselves with other gods and bow down to them. And they don't take long to do it, either.

cards.question: They quickly turned from the way of their ___, who had walked in obedience to the LORD's commandments.

cards.text: Whenever the LORD raises up a judge, and I mean EVERY time, He's with that judge. He saves Israel from their enemies for as long as that judge is still alive.

cards.question: The LORD keeps saving Israel this way because He is moved to pity by their groaning under those who oppress them.
When a judge dies, what happens to Israel?

answers.text: They become even more corrupt than their fathers
They turn back to the LORD for good
They ask for a king to rule them

cards.text: They won't give up their evil practices and stubborn ways. So the anger of the LORD burns against Israel, and He speaks.

cards.question: The LORD's anger burns against Israel. What does He say this nation has done?

answers.text: Broken His covenant and ignored His voice
Crowned a king without asking Him
Left the land He promised them

cards.question: The LORD says He will no longer drive out before them any of the ___ Joshua left when he died.
Why does the LORD say He's leaving those nations in place?

answers.text: To test whether Israel will walk in His way
To pay tribute to Israel every year
To guard the borders of the land

cards.text: Ohhh, so THAT's why the LORD had left those nations in place! He hadn't driven them out right away by handing them over to Joshua.
These are the nations the LORD left to test all the Israelites who had never known any of the wars in Canaan.

cards.question: These nations were also left to teach ___ to later generations of Israel who had not known it.

cards.text: Here's the lineup: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites up in the mountains of Lebanon. And I thought the back of a junk drawer was crowded!
These nations were left to test whether Israel would keep the LORD's commandments, the ones He gave their fathers through Moses, Israel's leader before Joshua.
So the Israelites keep living among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites. That's six peoples, friend, and Israel is right in the middle of all of them.

cards.question: Living side by side with these peoples, what do the Israelites end up doing?

answers.text: Marrying into them and serving their gods
Driving them out of the land at last
Teaching them the ways of the LORD
